tasks.short: Collect patient history and lifestyle information

steps.what: Collect medical histories and clarify general health and lifestyle information with patients

tasks.design: Keep history collection and clarification in the consultation, supported by the {OTHER} clinical record system. Do not treat a questionnaire or generated summary as a substitute for asking about unclear or incomplete information.
tasks.previous_blocker: Relevant history often emerges through clarification rather than fixed fields.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing clinical records provide context without establishing shorter history-taking time.
tasks.still_hard: Patients may not recognize which symptoms, medicines or changes matter.
tasks.human_edge: The practitioner builds trust and notices contradictions that need further questions.
tasks.altitude: Nothing changes in history-taking responsibility or assumed time.

reach.task: Help a patient articulate unanswered care questions

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: substantive history collection and clarification retain human time; documentation assistance is a separate opportunity.

assumptions: Boundary is collecting and clarifying history, excluding separate production of care-plan records and diagnostic judgement.

The patient supplies history during the conversation; the acupuncturist captures and checks it in counted s1. Missing or uncertain information prompts manual follow-up, never a presumed complete-history flag.
The {OTHER} category is a clinical record system; inspect native history forms before custom tools.
Zero incremental upkeep because no new automation or mandatory questionnaire is introduced.
unknowns: Existing intake process and record completeness
research_questions: Is any distinct duplicate transcription measurable without reducing clinical clarification?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100 gross0 upkeep0 net0. Complete and uncertain histories both retain the history-taking interaction; separate record-writing savings are not counted here.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Gather care plans, prognoses and changes for the correct patient encounter
Write detailed records of health care plans and prognoses

loop.purpose: Draft an encounter note from explicit practitioner-provided material
loop.output: Care record draft with unresolved gaps
loop.check: Compare patient identity, decisions, uncertainty, chronology and omissions with the recording brief
loop.stop: One draft and correction; unclear clinical content is entered manually
loop.why_not_simpler: Plans and prognoses contain varied narrative; structured templates alone do not capture all wording

steps.what: Check completeness and save the exact final care record

tasks.design: Use native templates in the {OTHER} clinical record system, adding bounded note drafting only where free text remains. The practitioner checks the draft against explicit care decisions and saves the final record personally.
tasks.previous_blocker: Turning care decisions into complete narrative records required repeated typing.
tasks.enabler_now: Clinical note-drafting tools can propose text for practitioner validation.
tasks.still_hard: Omitted uncertainty or altered chronology can misrepresent what was decided.
tasks.human_edge: The practitioner distinguishes an accurate record from fluent but unsupported text.
tasks.altitude: A little typing time returns to record completeness; care decisions stay unchanged.

evidence.claim: Autoscriber drafts consultation notes for clinician validation; this supports documentation assistance, not autonomous care planning or proven acupuncture-specific savings.
Model knowledge: the proposed drafting saving requires local measurement.

assumptions: Boundary begins with established care decisions and ends with a checked record. History-taking and diagnostic reasoning retain their own time and are not saved again here.

The acupuncturist captures in counted s1 patient and encounter identifiers, date, explicit plan, prognosis wording, uncertainty, changes and source notes. No ambient recording is assumed. Missing material is obtained and entered manually before finalization; the model must not infer care decisions.
The {OTHER} category is a clinical record system; test native structured templates and reuse functions before adding a model.
Five incremental focal hours cover template review and omission audits; three other-role hours cover access and integration upkeep.
unknowns: Clinical system capabilities and permitted processing environment
research_questions: Does checked drafting reduce total documentation time while preserving decisions and uncertainty?

approvals.approved_version: Exact patient, encounter, note text, plan, prognosis and timestamp; any change requires renewed approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 B100 R89.5 gives10.5 gross minus5 focal upkeep =5.5 net. Brief existing templates or extensive note corrections support only0-2% conservative saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Educate patients about suitable techniques and check understanding through discussion and demonstration

tasks.design: Use vetted material in {DOCS} while retaining personal explanation and demonstration. The practitioner checks understanding and adapts the instruction to the patient's needs and limitations.
tasks.previous_blocker: Knowing whether advice has been understood requires interaction.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing teaching material supports consistent explanations without establishing shorter patient education time.
tasks.still_hard: A patient may misunderstand technique or be unable to follow generic instructions.
tasks.human_edge: The practitioner notices discomfort, confusion and barriers that require a different explanation.
tasks.altitude: Nothing changes in patient education responsibility or contact time.

reach.task: Identify barriers to understanding care information

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: personal education and demonstration remain fully counted; generic handouts do not establish equivalent understanding.

assumptions: Boundary is patient education, excluding separate material authorship, care-plan documentation and clinical diagnosis.
The practitioner assesses patient needs and captures the understanding check during counted s1; no automated comprehension flag is assumed.
Use native document libraries before custom educational content generation.
Zero incremental upkeep because no new automation or additional material-maintenance process is proposed.
research_questions: Can existing material improve understanding without shortening necessary interaction?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100 gross0 upkeep0 net0. Familiar techniques and patients needing repeated explanation both retain direct instruction time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Analyze findings and history for traditional diagnosis

steps.what: Analyze physical findings and medical histories to make diagnoses within professional scope

tasks.design: Keep diagnostic analysis with the practitioner, using the {OTHER} clinical record system for findings and history. No automated diagnosis or efficacy claim for a traditional diagnostic framework is introduced.
tasks.previous_blocker: Diagnostic reasoning depends on interpreting incomplete and potentially conflicting information.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing clinical records supply context; the digest establishes no autonomous diagnostic capability for this task.
tasks.still_hard: Uncertain findings and concerns outside professional scope need qualified human assessment.
tasks.human_edge: The practitioner recognizes uncertainty and the need for further assessment or referral.
tasks.altitude: Nothing changes in diagnostic responsibility or assumed reasoning time.

reach.task: Help patients articulate questions for further clinical assessment
reach.learn: Scope boundaries and clear communication of uncertainty

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: interpreting findings remains human judgement; the supplied digest does not establish autonomous diagnosis for this task.

assumptions: Boundary is reasoning over existing findings and history, excluding history collection, physical examination, separate record maintenance and treatment.

The examining practitioner produces physical findings and the history-taking practitioner produces the clarified history before analysis. Their work is separately owned; checking completeness and resolving uncertainty remain fully counted in s1. No diagnosis or safety flag is presumed available.
The {OTHER} category is a clinical record system; use native record views before custom decision support.
Zero incremental upkeep because no automated diagnostic tool or recurring process is added.
unknowns: Existing diagnostic workflow and information completeness
research_questions: Is any separately measured retrieval overhead present without changing diagnostic reasoning?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100 gross0 upkeep0 net0. Routine and ambiguous assessments both retain human reasoning; upstream collection time is neither removed nor counted twice.

role.altitude: Documentation assistance may return a little typing time while history collection, patient education and diagnostic judgement remain personal.
reach: Help record specialists identify missing encounter information
Help patient representatives communicate uncertainty and unanswered care questions
role.ambitious_version: A practitioner with accurate records and more attention available for patient clarification and understanding.
